title: Asymptotic analysis of the confluent Dotsenko-Fateev system
summary: The Dotsenko-Fateev equation is a third-order linear ordinary differential equation studied in two-dimensional conformal field theory. We study the confluent Dotsenko-Fateev system, a rank-three system of linear ordinary differential equations obtained by confluence from a first-order system equivalent to the Dotsenko-Fateev equation. It has an irregular singular point at infinity, and its solutions admit double integral representations of confluent Selberg type.
